current_prompt.body:
FIND all exact covers of the universe U = {1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9} using the sets S1 = {1,2,3}, S2 = {4,5,6}, S3 = {7,8,9}, S4 = {1,4,7}, S5 = {2,5,8}, S6 = {3,6,9}, S7 = {1,5,9}, S8 = {2,6,7}, S9 = {3,4,8}.
OUTPUT each exact cover as a list of the selected sets.
INCLUDE a self-contained test that verifies each solution covers U exactly once.
NOTE the entities are U, S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6, S7, S8, S9, Algorithm X, dancing links.

current_plan.body:
BUILD problem representation using universe U and sets S1 through S9
CONSTRUCT dancing links data structure for the exact cover matrix
APPLY Algorithm X to recursively search for exact covers
FOR each exact cover found
    EMIT the list of selected sets
    VALIDATE that each element of U appears exactly once in the solution
ENDFOR
GENERATE a self-contained test that iterates over all emitted solutions and asserts the exact‑cover property
